features.name: app_bootstrap_root
features.description: Create the production Next.js app at the repository root with pnpm, strict TypeScript, Tailwind 4, Sass support, lint/format tooling, and a Vercel-ready baseline.

features.name: visual_foundation_tokens
features.description: Migrate the prototype design language into reusable tokens, global styles, fonts, and UI primitives, including a simplified V1 image-slot replacement.

features.name: application_shell_navigation
features.description: Implement the persistent App Router shell with Header, Sidebar, site/nav config, route placeholders, and client hooks only where interaction requires them.

features.name: data_model_normalization
features.description: Replace browser globals with typed domain contracts and TypeScript seed modules for spells, monsters, chronicles, timeline, characters, and places.

features.name: global_index_search
features.description: Build the /index experience with typed cross-domain search, grouped results, and behavior comparable to the prototype SearchView.

features.name: bestiary_vertical_slice
features.description: Migrate the bestiary into browseable list and detail routes with typed monster data, badges, and end-to-end usability.

features.name: chronicles_and_scriptorium
features.description: Implement the /scriptorium, /chronicles, and /chronicles/[id] routes using typed chronicle and timeline data with reusable chronology components.

features.name: characters_catalog
features.description: Port the characters domain into typed list and detail routes, including portrait strategy under public/portraits.

features.name: places_catalog
features.description: Port the places domain into typed list and detail routes and prepare atlas-facing location metadata.

features.name: atlas_interactive_maps
features.description: Migrate the atlas with responsive map assets, pin positioning, and place-linked interactions that stay visually stable across viewports.

features.name: grimoire_codex_rules
features.description: Complete the core knowledge sections with grimoire list/detail routes, codex collection routes, shared rendering primitives, and a rules page.

features.name: sanctum_modal_routes
features.description: Migrate Sanctum into parallel/intercepting routes with client-side tabbed forms, route-based modal behavior, and no real persistence in V1.

features.name: sanctum_persistence
features.description: Add deployment-compatible persistence for Sanctum create/read flows with validated server-side storage, schema design, and optional starter seeds.
